WITH PARAMETROS AS (
    SELECT GREATEST(
               TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'),
               ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -3)
           ) AS DATA_INICIO,
           TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AS DATA_FIM
    FROM DUAL
),
FATURAMENTO_BASE AS (
  SELECT
    PCMOV.CODCLI AS CODIGOCLIENTE,
    PCPRODUT.CODFORNEC AS CODIGOFORNECEDOR,
    CAST(NVL(RCA_OFC.CODUSUR_OFC,
         NVL(PCMOV.RCAVENDA, PCMOV.CODUSUR)) AS NUMERIC(16,0)) AS CODIGORCAVENDA,
    CAST(
        NVL(
            NVL(ROUND(PCMOVCOMPLE.VLSUBTOTITEM, 2), -- Lógica simplificada aqui
            (ROUND(
                (DECODE(PCMOV.CODOPER,
                        'S', (NVL(DECODE(PCNFSAID.CONDVENDA, 7, DECODE(NVL(PCMOV.TIPOITEM, 'C'), 'C', PCMOV.QT, PCMOV.QTCONT), PCMOV.QT), 0)),
                        'ST', (NVL(DECODE(PCNFSAID.CONDVENDA, 7, DECODE(NVL(PCMOV.TIPOITEM, 'C'), 'C', PCMOV.QT, PCMOV.QTCONT), PCMOV.QT), 0)),
                        'SM', (NVL(DECODE(PCNFSAID.CONDVENDA, 7, DECODE(NVL(PCMOV.TIPOITEM, 'C'), 'C', PCMOV.QT, PCMOV.QTCONT), PCMOV.QT), 0)),
                        0))
                * ((NVL(
                        DECODE(
                        PCNFSAID.CONDVENDA
                        , 7, DECODE(NVL(PCMOV.TIPOITEM, 'C'), 'C', NVL(PCMOV.PUNIT, 0), PCMOV.PUNITCONT) + NVL(PCMOV.VLFRETE, 0) + NVL(PCMOV.VLOUTRASDESP, 0) + NVL(PCMOV.VLFRETE_RATEIO, 0) + NVL(PCMOV.VLOUTROS, 0)
                        , NVL(PCMOV.PUNIT, 0) + NVL(PCMOV.VLFRETE, 0) + NVL(PCMOV.VLOUTRASDESP, 0) + NVL(PCMOV.VLFRETE_RATEIO, 0) + NVL(PCMOV.VLOUTROS, 0))
                    , 0))
                    - NVL(PCMOV.VLIPI, 0)
                    - NVL(PCMOV.ST, 0))
            , 2))
            + ROUND(
                NVL(PCMOV.VLIPI, 0) * (DECODE(PCMOV.CODOPER,
                        'S', (NVL(DECODE(PCNFSAID.CONDVENDA, 7, DECODE(NVL(PCMOV.TIPOITEM, 'C'), 'C', PCMOV.QT, PCMOV.QTCONT), PCMOV.QT), 0)),
                        'ST', (NVL(DECODE(PCNFSAID.CONDVENDA, 7, DECODE(NVL(PCMOV.TIPOITEM, 'C'), 'C', PCMOV.QT, PCMOV.QTCONT), PCMOV.QT), 0)),
                        'SM', (NVL(DECODE(PCNFSAID.CONDVENDA, 7, DECODE(NVL(PCMOV.TIPOITEM, 'C'), 'C', PCMOV.QT, PCMOV.QTCONT), PCMOV.QT), 0)),
                        0))
            , 2)
            + ROUND(
                NVL(PCMOV.ST, 0) * (DECODE(PCMOV.CODOPER,
                        'S', (NVL(DECODE(PCNFSAID.CONDVENDA, 7, DECODE(NVL(PCMOV.TIPOITEM, 'C'), 'C', PCMOV.QT, PCMOV.QTCONT), PCMOV.QT), 0)),
                        'ST', (NVL(DECODE(PCNFSAID.CONDVENDA, 7, DECODE(NVL(PCMOV.TIPOITEM, 'C'), 'C', PCMOV.QT, PCMOV.QTCONT), PCMOV.QT), 0)),
                        'SM', (NVL(DECODE(PCNFSAID.CONDVENDA, 7, DECODE(NVL(PCMOV.TIPOITEM, 'C'), 'C', PCMOV.QT, PCMOV.QTCONT), PCMOV.QT), 0)),
                        0))
            , 2))
        , 0)
    AS NUMERIC(18,6)) AS VALORTOTAL_CALCULADO
  FROM OKAJIMA.PCNFSAID
    INNER JOIN OKAJIMA.PCPLPAG ON PCPLPAG.CODPLPAG = PCNFSAID.CODPLPAG
    INNER JOIN OKAJIMA.PCMOV ON PCNFSAID.NUMNOTA = PCMOV.NUMNOTA AND PCNFSAID.NUMTRANSVENDA = PCMOV.NUMTRANSVENDA
    INNER JOIN OKAJIMA.PCPRODUT ON PCMOV.CODPROD = PCPRODUT.CODPROD
    LEFT JOIN OKAJIMA.PCMOVCOMPLE ON PCMOV.NUMTRANSITEM = PCMOVCOMPLE.NUMTRANSITEM
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT MIN(I.CODUSUR_OFC) AS CODUSUR_OFC
        FROM OKAJIMA.PCPEDI I
        WHERE I.NUMPED = PCMOV.NUMPED
          AND I.CODPROD = PCMOV.CODPROD
          AND I.CODUSUR_OFC IS NOT NULL
    ) RCA_OFC ON 1 = 1
    CROSS JOIN PARAMETROS P
  WHERE
    NVL(PCNFSAID.TIPOVENDA, 'X') NOT IN ('SR', 'DF')
    AND PCNFSAID.DTCANCEL IS NULL
    AND NVL(PCMOV.TIPOITEM, 'C') IN ('C', 'N')
    AND PCNFSAID.CODFISCAL <> 0
    AND PCNFSAID.CODFISCAL NOT IN (722, 532, 632, 732)
    AND PCNFSAID.CONDVENDA NOT IN (0, 4, 8, 10, 13, 20, 98, 99)
    AND PCNFSAID.CODCLI NOT IN (247, 24805, 29828, 24806, 31134)
    AND PCNFSAID.DTSAIDA >= P.DATA_INICIO
    AND PCNFSAID.DTSAIDA <  P.DATA_FIM
    AND PCMOV.CODFILIAL IN ('2', '3')
),
MOVIMENTOS_FORNECEDOR AS (
    SELECT
        F.CODIGOCLIENTE,
        F.CODIGOFORNECEDOR,
        SUM(NVL(F.VALORTOTAL_CALCULADO, 0)) AS VALOR_LIQUIDO
    FROM FATURAMENTO_BASE F
    LEFT JOIN OKAJIMA.OKA_ROTAS_VW R
      ON R.CODUSUR = F.CODIGORCAVENDA
     AND R.CODCLI = F.CODIGOCLIENTE
     AND R.CODFORNEC = F.CODIGOFORNECEDOR
    WHERE F.CODIGORCAVENDA NOT IN (325, 4119, 4668, 7305)
       OR F.CODIGORCAVENDA IS NULL
    GROUP BY F.CODIGOCLIENTE, F.CODIGOFORNECEDOR

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        D.CODIGOCLIENTE,
        D.CODIGOFORNECEDOR,
        -SUM(NVL(D.VALORTOTAL, 0)) AS VALOR_LIQUIDO
    FROM OKAJIMA.OKJ_FATODEVOLUCAO_PBI D
    CROSS JOIN PARAMETROS P
    WHERE D.DATADEVOLUCAO >= P.DATA_INICIO
      AND D.DATADEVOLUCAO <  P.DATA_FIM
      AND D.CODIGOFILIAL IN ('2', '3')
      AND (D.CODIGORCAVENDA NOT IN (325, 4119, 4668, 7305)
           OR D.CODIGORCAVENDA IS NULL)
    GROUP BY D.CODIGOCLIENTE, D.CODIGOFORNECEDOR
),
FATURAMENTO_CLIENTE_PASTA AS (
    SELECT M.CODIGOCLIENTE,
           NVL(TRIM(F.PASTA_CAMPANHA), 'SEM PASTA') AS PASTA,
           ROUND(SUM(M.VALOR_LIQUIDO), 2) AS FATURAMENTO_LIQUIDO_3M
    FROM MOVIMENTOS_FORNECEDOR M
    LEFT JOIN OKAJIMA.OKJ_DIMFORNECEDOR_PBI F
      ON F.CODIGO_FORNECEDOR = M.CODIGOFORNECEDOR
    GROUP BY M.CODIGOCLIENTE,
             NVL(TRIM(F.PASTA_CAMPANHA), 'SEM PASTA')
),
CLIENTES AS (
    SELECT C.CODIGOCLIENTE,
           C.CODIGORAMOATIVIDADE AS CODRAM,
           NVL(TRIM(C.RAMOATIVIDADE), 'NAO INFORMADO') AS RAMOATIVIDADE,
           CASE
             WHEN INSTR(UPPER(C.DDD_CANAL), 'DDD 91') > 0 THEN 'DDD 91'
             WHEN INSTR(UPPER(C.DDD_CANAL), 'DDD 93') > 0 THEN 'DDD 93'
             WHEN INSTR(UPPER(C.DDD_CANAL), 'DDD 94') > 0 THEN 'DDD 94'
             ELSE 'OUTROS'
           END AS DDD
    FROM OKAJIMA.OKJ_DIMCLIENTE_PBI C
)
SELECT /*+ GATHER_PLAN_STATISTICS */ /* POTENCIAL_3M_CANDIDATA */
       CAST(C.CODRAM AS NUMBER(16,0)) AS CODRAM,
       C.RAMOATIVIDADE, C.DDD, F.PASTA,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS NUMBER(16,0)) AS QT_CLIENTE,
       CAST(ROUND(SUM(F.FATURAMENTO_LIQUIDO_3M), 2)
            AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS FAT_3_MESES,
       CAST(ROUND(AVG(F.FATURAMENTO_LIQUIDO_3M), 2)
            AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS MEDIA_FAT_3_MESES
FROM FATURAMENTO_CLIENTE_PASTA F
INNER JOIN CLIENTES C ON C.CODIGOCLIENTE = F.CODIGOCLIENTE
GROUP BY C.CODRAM, C.RAMOATIVIDADE, C.DDD, F.PASTA
